from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalJudgment(BaseModel):
    """A single legal judgment document with its title and identified cause category."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 X》')")
    identified_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause category identified in the text, matching the provided task list")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document that anchors the title and cause identification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all judgment documents extracted from the input collection."""
    judgments: list[LegalJudgment]
